The Final Battle!
Door to the Demon Realm
Good, you’re all here.
What’s up, Kaede?
We’ve just picked up strange readings from below the Mikasa.
Seismic activity has been detected in the Mikasa’s vicinity.
We’re picking up massive spirit energy readings coming from underground.
There you have it.
It’s got to be that Demon Lord of theirs!
No, we don’t know that for sure just yet.
Yes, it could just be unrelated natural phenomena. A volcanic eruption, perhaps?
But... There aren’t any active volcanoes down there...
Well there’s no point just sitting around hypothesizing.

That’s right.
We have to investigate.
Should we all go?
No, we can’t.
<NAME>, do you think you can do this?
Yes.
Yes, ma’am.
Go get ‘em, <NAME>!!
What’s the matter, <NAME>?

You’ll be fine, !
Go get ‘em!!
Okay.
Kaede, we’ve pinpointed the location of the energy source.
It’s coming from deeper underground than the Sacred Demon Castle.

Very well then,
here are your orders,
.
You are to investigate this unidentified surge of spirit power below the Sacred Demon Castle.
Roger!
Take these with you, just in case.
The Pandemonium Regalia?
Everything that’s happened has been due to the Regalia.
They might be of some use against what lies ahead.
Best of luck.
